store.tagline: Talk with your agent, hands-free, and hear it answer
store.description:
Hold the button and speak; your Möbius agent answers out loud in the voice you picked in the Voice app.

• Hold to talk, or tap to start and tap again to send (up to 60 seconds).
• Accurate speech recognition that copes well with accents (NVIDIA Parakeet, runs on your own Möbius server; a ~104 MB model downloads once on first open).
• Answers are read aloud sentence by sentence as they're written, with the voice kept loaded so replies start quickly.
• Question cards are read aloud too, and you can answer them by voice.
• Every conversation is an ordinary chat in your Recents, using your own models.

Needs the Voice app with a voice downloaded.
